parameters.name: [Auto tuning]
parameters.description: Auto-tuning of the motor. During auto-tuning the motor operates at nominal current. Auto-tuning may take 1 to 2 seconds.
parameters.setting_conditions: Auto-tuning is only performed if no command has been activated.

options.label: [Yes]: Auto-tuning is performed as soon as possible, then the parameter automatically changes to [Done] (dOnE) or [No] (nO)
[Done]: Use of the values given the last time auto-tuning was performed
[Drv running]: Auto-tuning is performed every time a run command is sent
[Power on]: Auto-tuning is performed on every power-up
[LI1] to [LI16]: Auto-tuning is performed on the transition from 0 to 1 of a logic input assigned to this function

parameters.evidence_quote: v [No] (nO): Auto-tuning not performed v [Yes] (YES): Auto-tuning is performed as soon as possible, then the parameter automatically changes to [Done] (dOnE) or [No] (nO)

notes: This programming manual (BBV46385) does not contain a Modbus register/address map, control/status word bit tables, or supported function codes. Page 7 states that communication details are in separate 'Manuals for Modbus, CANopen, etc.'. No modbus_registers records were created.
Page 25 only lists functions that can be assigned to bits 11 to 15 of the Network and Modbus control word (e.g. PS2, PS4, rPS, FSt, dCI, rFC, CCS); the control word address itself is not given.
